Title: n8n: Edit Image Node Format Injection Allows Arbitrary File Write
Description: The n8n Edit Image node passed its output format to the underlying image library without validation, so a crafted value could write bytes to a location outside the node's working directory. An authenticated user able to run workflows could use this to write arbitrary files in the n8n instance.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 1.123.67, all versions starting from 2.0.0-rc.0 before 2.31.5, all versions starting from 2.32.0 before 2.32.1
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 1.123.67 before 2.0.0-rc.0, all versions starting from 2.31.5 before 2.32.0, all versions starting from 2.32.1
